description: Four channels of attenuversion, offset and microtonal quantisation, each with an unquantised and a quantised output.

params.text: Shifts the quantised output by whole scale steps, from an octave down to an octave up.
Sets how many equal divisions the octave is split into, 1 to 24, with 12 giving ordinary semitones.
Attenuates and inverts the range CV of that column, -1 to +1.
Multiplies the input signal of that column, -2 to +2, with the attenuverted range CV added to it first.
Attenuates and inverts the offset CV of that column, -1 to +1.
Adds a fixed voltage to that column after the range section, -10V to +10V.

inputs.text: The signal that column attenuverts, offsets and quantises.
Adds to the range knob of that column through the small range attenuverter, modulating the multiplication applied to the input.
Adds to the offset knob of that column through the small offset attenuverter.

outputs.text: The column's input multiplied by the range setting and shifted by the offset setting, with no quantisation.
The attenuverted and offset signal snapped to the programmed scale, the input range spread equally between the allowed notes rather than each note taking the voltages nearest it.

notes: the scale is typed into the text field as the number of steps from each note to the next, so 43 gives a major triad and 221222 a major scale; the closing step back to the root is implied.
the text field comes up holding 221222, an ordinary major scale, so the quantised outputs work before anything is typed.
menu: Scale Presets — types a scale into the text field: Major, Natural Minor, the two pentatonics, Blues, Chromatic, Harmonic Minor, Whole-Tone, Whole-Half Diminished, and seven chord shapes.
Gain Mode — sets one column to Bipolar, where a negative effective gain inverts the input, or to VCA Mode (Unipolar Gain), where the gain and both outputs are clamped at 0.
Set All To Bipolar — puts all four columns into bipolar gain at once, and Set All To Unipolar puts all four into VCA mode.
